name: Raydium AMM
description: Raydium's original AMM (v4) on Solana, the constant-product pools that Raydium runs with the OpenBook order book. An agent can swap through a pool, add liquidity, and remove liquidity. Raydium's REST API lists pools, mints and prices.

keyFunctions.description: Swap an exact amount of the input token for at least minimum_amount_out of the output token. Uses the AMM only (order book disabled). Amounts are in token base units.
Receive an exact amount_out of the output token, spending at most max_amount_in of the input token. AMM only.
Original exact-input swap, which can also match the OpenBook order book. Prefer the V2 variant for new integrations.
Original exact-output swap, which can also use the order book. Prefer the V2 variant.

keyFunctions.signature: Deposit(max_coin_amount: u64, max_pc_amount: u64, base_side: u64, other_amount_min: Option<u64>)
keyFunctions.description: Add liquidity to a pool. Deposits at the current pool ratio, up to max_coin_amount of the coin token and max_pc_amount of the PC token. base_side selects which side the ratio is taken from. Receives LP tokens.

keyFunctions.signature: Withdraw(amount: u64, min_coin_amount: Option<u64>, min_pc_amount: Option<u64>)
keyFunctions.description: Burn amount LP tokens and receive pool tokens at the current ratio, failing if below the optional minimums.

keyFunctions.signature: Initialize2(nonce: u8, open_time: u64, init_pc_amount: u64, init_coin_amount: u64)
keyFunctions.description: Create a new AMM pool for a market, with the initial PC and coin amounts that set the starting price. Pool creation fee applies.

keyFunctions.signature: SetParams(param: u8, value: Option<u64>, fees: Option<Fees>)
keyFunctions.description: Admin only: change pool parameters or fees.
Admin only: update the AMM config account (for example the owner or the pool creation fee).
Admin only: withdraw accumulated profit from the pool to the protocol.

offchainApis.name: Raydium API V3: main info
offchainApis.use: GET main statistics for the Raydium venues.

offchainApis.name: Raydium API V3: pools by id
offchainApis.use: GET pool info (mints, vaults, LP mint, fees, price, TVL) for one or more pool ids. Cached about 60 seconds. Use it to resolve the pool before building a swap or liquidity transaction.

offchainApis.name: Raydium API V3: pools by mint
offchainApis.use: GET pools that contain a mint, or a mint pair. pageSize is capped at 1000. Use it to find the pool for a token pair.

offchainApis.name: Raydium API V3: list pools (cursor paging)
offchainApis.use: GET a paged list of pools with nextPageId cursor. size is capped at 1000.

offchainApis.name: Raydium API V3: token prices
offchainApis.use: GET the price for one or more mints.

actions.name: swap
actions.description: Swap one token for another in a Raydium AMM v4 pool
actions.how: GET the pool from /pools/info/mint (or /pools/info/ids), build SwapBaseInV2(amount_in, minimum_amount_out) with the pool's accounts (amm, vaults, authority, user token accounts), sign and send. Compute minimum_amount_out from the pool reserves and your slippage.

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.description: Deposit two tokens into a pool and receive LP tokens
actions.how: Deposit(max_coin_amount, max_pc_amount, base_side, other_amount_min) at the current ratio; check the pool's LP mint and ratio first

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.description: Burn LP tokens for the two underlying tokens

actions.name: create-pool
actions.description: Create a new AMM v4 pool for a market
actions.how: Initialize2 with the market id and the starting amounts. The pool needs an existing OpenBook market and a pool creation fee.

risks: Constant-product pools lose value to arbitrage when prices move, which is impermanent loss for liquidity providers.
Low-liquidity pools have high price impact. Set minimum_amount_out on every swap.
Anyone can create a pool for any token pair, including fake or scam tokens. Check the mint before swapping or providing liquidity.
AMM v4 is the older Raydium program. Newer Raydium pool types (CPMM, CLMM) are separate programs and are not covered here.
The program is upgradeable by its maintainers. Admin instructions are not for ordinary users.
notes: Mainnet program id 675kPX9MHTjS2zt1qfr1NYHuzeLXfQM9H24wFSUt1Mp8 is listed on the official raydium-amm README under Program Deployments (devnet id DRaya7Kj3aMWQSy19kSjvmuwq9docCHofyP9kanQGaav is left out). Instruction names come from the AmmInstruction enum in program/src/instruction.rs of the official repository. Individual pool, market and authority addresses are not included; get them from the API. Raydium's Swap transaction API and other products are not covered here.
